move: old logo settles, a glowing divider wipes across revealing the rebrand, then sweeps back
how: Two full-frame halves: a cream 'before' with a serif circular monogram and italic wordmark, and a dark 'after' with a rounded blue tile and lowercase grotesk wordmark, the after layer hidden by clip-path inset from the right, plus a white divider bar with a knob and Before/After pills. 0-12%: the old mark eases in from scale .6, rotation -40 (expo.out), the name from x 30, the tag and pill fade. At 24% a proxy tween p 0->1 (expo.inOut, 1.3s) drives onUpdate that moves the bar x and sets the after clip to inset(0 (W-x)px 0 0), revealing the rebrand left to right. Under the wipe at 30% the new mark pops from scale .5 rotation -25 with back.out(2), the name slides from x -40 (expo.out), the tag and pill fade in. At 72% the proxy returns p 1->0 (1.1s), covering the rebrand again while the old logo slides x -30 and fades out with power2.in. The last frame is the cream side with the logo gone.
adapt: Replace both logos and wordmarks, both background colours, the Before/After labels and the tags. Keep the 1.3s expo.inOut wipe and the 0.3s lead of the new-mark pop after the wipe starts.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the two halves, the bar and labels inside el; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with the wipe at 0.24D-0.5D and the return at 0.72D-0.94D; the proxy onUpdate uses W = 1280 and must use el.offsetWidth instead and scope its gsap.set calls to el's .bar and .after. All from() tweens need immediateRender:false when nested; the file calls tl.seek(0) at the end to pre-apply the from states.
caveats: from() tweens need immediateRender:false when nested
the old logo fades out at the end, so the loop does not close
ends with an empty cream frame
